Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the calendar invite for next Tuesday. Quick update from our side — we just kicked off a multi-week data migration sprint and leadership has asked us to pause all new ML/LLM pilot work until that completes. That means we need to deprioritize the inference demo for the time being.

We still want to see what Redwood offers, but the earliest realistic window for a live demo will be 6–8 weeks out. In the meantime can you:
- Share a short recording of the demo and the proposed SOW (so our procurement folks can review asynchronously)
- Flag any prerequisites we should know about (data access, network/VPN, compliance docs)

Also heads up — several of our folks (including Priyanka, cc'd) will be on site with a client next week, so travel + meetings add to the scheduling difficulty.

Appreciate your flexibility — can we park the live session and reconvene in early July?

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao

Meridian Health

- Monica (CS) can propose a 30-minute follow-up call the week of July 6th as a tentative placeholder; no prep required on your side until then.

We can also offer a one-time evaluation credit and priority onboarding slot if you decide to pick the pilot back up — happy to discuss with you and Priyanka.

If that works, I'll: (1) upload the recording and SOW to a shared Drive link, (2) mark the HubSpot deal as "On Hold — customer deprioritized", and (3) set a tentative calendar hold for the first week of July.

Would you prefer we keep the current meeting on the calendar as a placeholder or remove it entirely and rebook later?

Thanks again, and safe travels next week.

Best,
